}}'''Pritalle Nerbaijan''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Pritalle Nerbaijan}}

==Appearance==
She has green tilted eyes, but has only a trace of the typical Saldaean nose.{{ref/book|10|p}}

==History==
She is from [[Saldaea]].

She was an [[Accepted]] in the [[White Tower]] during the [[Aiel War]] when the [[Dragon]] was reborn.

She doesn't hide the fact that she dislikes teaching Novices and Accepted.

She has a single [[Warder]], [[Harril]].

==Activities==
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split.

She is one of the sisters who captured [[Egwene al'Vere]] at [[Northharbor]] and brought her back to the White Tower.

She is one of the Aes Sedai who gave private lessons to Egwene.
